newsitem.title: USA: Lawyer says police lack evidence in Cosby killing.
newsitem.headline: Lawyer says police lack evidence in Cosby killing.

text.p: A lawyer for the man charged with killing the only son of entertainer Bill Cosby said on Friday the fact police reportedly found no fingerprints on the murder gun showed flaws in the prosecution case.
"In any capital case, before you speak of executing somebody, you'd better make damn sure you've got the right guy," attorney Darren Kavinoky told reporters.
He said he and prosecutors had been summoned to court later in the day to discuss "discovery" issues -- the sharing of evidence in the case.
"The caveat is -- we have not been provided with all discovery material," Kavinoky said.

His client, Mikhail "Michael" Markhasev, has been charged with murdering Ennis Cosby on Jan. 16. The only son of Bill Cosby was shot by the side of a southern California freeway while he was changing a flat tire.
The Los Angeles District Attorney's office declined to comment, saying it would try the case in court, rather than outside. It also said the defence had been given copies of all evidence in the case.
Commenting on reports that police found no usable fingerprints on the alleged murder weapon, Kavinoky said: "It's a critical piece of evidence -- or lack of evidence."

His colleague, lawyer Dale Rubin said on Thursday the fact there were no prints on the gun, which was found in a field a month after the murder, was not as important as the fact that the only known witness in the case had apparently failed to pick Markhasev out of a police lineup.

A woman who Cosby had phoned to shine her car lights while he changed the tire, told police she was confronted by the killer on the night of the murder. He told her to drive away and when she returned, Cosby, 27, was dead from a single shot to the head.
Last week, she reportedly failed to identify Markhasev in a police lineup.
Police believe Markhasev, an 18-year-old Ukarainian immigrant, shot Cosby in an attempt to steal his Mercedes-Benz convertible.
